name: single-ticket
description: One ticket through the whole loop: design pass, author sign-off, dev, checks, reconcile, merge, deploy, Done. The smallest rehearsal that touches every hop, so it is the one to run first when anything changes. Seeded in Designing rather than Todo on purpose — the Todo pull is the author choosing what to work on, which has no pipeline behaviour to exercise, so seeding behind it would stall every rehearsal on a human.

tickets.title: Add a farewell to the home screen
tickets.description:
The home screen greets the visitor by name. Add a farewell alongside it, worded by the greetings system rather than by the screen — the screen renders copy verbatim (see systems/greetings.md).

One screen, one system, no new dependencies.
